Definition
[Reflection in a half-space]

1. ch2:2.2.4-def-2\group Green’s Functions

For $x=(x_1,\ldots ,x_{n-1},x_n)\in \R ^n_+$, define \[ \overline x=(x_1,\ldots ,x_{n-1},-x_n). \]
